blocks.text: You can download reports for evaluating events that occurred in your cloud workloads and for assessing the security posture of your cloud environment. You can review the reports and assess ZPC's performance in proactively monitoring your workloads for security vulnerabilities and policy violations and how you can take the necessary remediation steps.
You can download Excel reports for:

blocks.item: Cloud Alerts
IaC Alerts
Cloud Assets
Vulnerabilities

blocks.text: You can schedule and generate Compliance reports. To learn more, see Scheduling Compliance Reports.
To download a cloud alerts or an IaC alerts report:

blocks.item: On the left navigation menu, select Alerts.
On the Alerts page, select the Cloud Alerts or IaC Alerts tab.
Click the Export icon.

blocks.text: See image.
A message appears indicating that the request is submitted and the report is being exported.
See image.

blocks.item: Next, click the Profile () icon on the left navigation menu.

blocks.text: The My Profile page appears.

blocks.item: On the My Profile page, click the My Downloads tab.

blocks.text: You can see the list of reports that you've requested.
See image.

blocks.item: Click the Download icon to download the report.

blocks.text: If the report is not yet generated, then the status shows as Pending. Refresh the page or revisit the page after some time to see the Download icon.
To download a Cloud Asset report:

blocks.item: Go to Cloud Posture > Cloud Assets.
On the Cloud Assets page, click the Export icon.

blocks.text: See image.
A message appears indicating that the request is submitted and the report is being exported.
See image.

blocks.item: Next, click the Profile () icon on the left navigation menu.
On the Profiles page, click the My Downloads tab.

blocks.text: You can see the list of reports that you've requested.
See image.

blocks.item: Click the Download icon to download the report.

blocks.text: If the report is not yet generated, then the status shows as Pending. Refresh the page or revisit the page after some time to see the Download icon.
To download a vulnerability report:

blocks.item: Go to Cloud Posture > Vulnerability Management.
On the Vulnerability Management page, select the Vulnerabilities or Container Registry Images or Cloud Workloads tab.
Click the Export icon.

A message appears indicating that the request is submitted and the report is being exported.
